images.caption: Figure 1:Discrimination-aware UME. (a) Color and spatial relations distinguish the relevant item from confusable alternatives. (b) MMEB-V2 overall performance versus encoding throughput for DiLE and existing embedding models. Throughput was measured on an NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 GPU.

Figure 2:Overview of DiLE. (a) Task-aware representation combines Task-guided Latent Space Learning and Shared–Private Expert Adaptation. (b) Discrimination-aware refinement transfers the teacher’s fine-grained relevance distribution to the student through On-Policy Hard-negative Distillation. Periodically refreshed student snapshots update candidate sets, targeting evolving retrieval ambiguities.
Figure 4:Qualitative examples of hard-negative refresh. The updated student retrieves new confusable candidates, keeping supervision focused on the distinctions it currently struggles to capture.
